description: No residency requirement: Global deployments allowed; only baseline safety and security checks

content_filter.why: Every model deployment needs an Azure AI content filter policy

prompt_shields.why: Jailbreak attempts in user prompts are detected and blocked

private_network.why: The Foundry resource is reachable only through private endpoints

tracing_enabled.why: UAT feedback and traces are recorded in Application Insights
